statement: Kernel-checked formalization of a classical finite van der Corput inequality; advisory statement coverage pending. For z:Nat->Complex, natural 1<=H<=N, and |z(n)|<=1 for n<N, put S=sum_(n<N) z(n) and T_d=sum_(n<N-d) z(n+d)*conj(z(n)). Then |S|^2<=2*N^2/H+(4*N/H)*sum_(1<=d<H)|T_d|. The overlap length is exactly N-d, without periodic completion or a cancellation hypothesis. The more general energy inequality H^2*|S|^2<=(N+H)*H*(N+2*sum_(1<=d<H)|T_d|) holds for every natural N,H under the same modulus bound. The module proves zero-padded row sums and overlaps, finite Cauchy-Schwarz, diagonal and off-diagonal bounds, and the odd-lattice specialization z(n)=exp(2*pi*i*f(a+2*n)) for every real-valued f on natural integers and natural a; each correlation is the exponential sum of the actual shifted phase difference over N-d terms. This supplies a classical finite input to the written OOEE estimate, not its correlation bounds, derivative tests, discrepancy estimates, poor-fibre theorem, or a termination or escape result.

Kernel-checked formalization of a classical quantitative second-derivative estimate; advisory statement coverage pending. For every natural N, real a, lambda>0 and C>=1, suppose f has derivative g and g has derivative q at every point of the closed interval [a,a+N]. If lambda<=q<=C*lambda throughout that interval, or -C*lambda<=q<=-lambda throughout it, then the norm of sum_(n<N) exp(2*pi*i*f(a+n)) is at most 4*C*N*sqrt(lambda)+8/sqrt(lambda). The analogous hypotheses on [a,a+2*N] give the spacing-two bound 8*C*N*sqrt(lambda)+4/sqrt(lambda). N=0 and the endpoint one lattice step beyond the final summand are retained. The discrete proof assumes lambda*(j-i)<=d(j)-d(i)<=U*(j-i) for all 0<=i<=j<N, with d(n)=F(n+1)-F(n), U>=0; for every 0<delta<=1/2 it proves norm(sum_(n<N) exp(2*pi*i*F(n)))<=(U*N+2)*(2*delta/lambda+2+1/delta). Integer-band partitioning counts both resonant ends and applies the proved Kusmin-Landau estimate to the middle block. Mean-value comparisons prove the continuous-to-discrete hypotheses. No cancellation or correlation bound is assumed. No Juggler production or discrepancy theorem is asserted. The subsequent OOEECurvature module proves actual carry-cell curvature and unweighted sums; carry Fourier errors and complete production remain outstanding in Lean.
